dialogs.joinwelcome:
{{name}}, welcome to the Lamp of Time!

When you enter the challenge area, you need to collect enough pumpkins before the countdown ends to continue the jack-o'-lantern duration and return before the jack-o'-lantern burns out. Only in this way can the evacuation be considered successful and the score will be calculated.

For detailed rules, please right click - Tutorial View
dialogs.welcome_new_player:
New players are welcome to join! 
Please watch this tutorial carefully to learn how to play the game!

There is a portal next to the birth point. When you enter the portal, you can spend 10 pumpkins to start the game. You can collect them by interacting with large and small pumpkins on the map. 
You only have 60 seconds initially. Picking up a small pumpkin can add 5 seconds to the time. Picking up a big pumpkin is equivalent to picking up 3 small pumpkins. 
Get back and enter the portal before time runs out! 
Otherwise the reward will be forfeited.

PS: You need to pick up at least 5 pumpkins to evacuate~

Press the "2" button below to continue
